_comment: LEVEL 3 (feature): complete JWT auth vertical slice — user model, register/login/refresh/me endpoints, schemas, service, password hashing. package_dir must match the project package name (stack-webapp sets it automatically).
name: feature-auth
description: Complete backend auth: user model + register/login/refresh/me endpoints, JWT, password hashing. Wire once with include_router.

variables.name: app_name
variables.description: Python package name, e.g. 'app' or 'demo_api' (drives all nested imports)

variables.name: secret_env
variables.description: Env var holding the JWT signing secret

notes: After applying: 1) set JWT_SECRET in .env, 2) app.include_router(router) in main.py, 3) make sure the User model is imported so SQLAlchemy creates the table (Base.metadata.create_all runs at app import), 4) protect routes with Depends(get_current_user). Login returns {access_token, token_type, expires_in} and the token carries the user's role claim — matches the frontend comp-login template and the feature-rbac require_role dependency. Refresh: POST /api/auth/refresh with a refresh-typed token. Password hashing uses stdlib pbkdf2 — no extra deps.
